# dol_cookbook

> recipes for dol tools


## Pages in this subsection

- [dol_cookbook](dol_cookbook.html.md): Cookbook for DOLs.
- [dol_cookbook.pipes](dol_cookbook.pipes.html.md): A bunch of useful function compositions (Pipe instances)
- [dol_cookbook.recipe_cached_keys](dol_cookbook.recipe_cached_keys.html.md): Recipe: avoid re-listing a slow store.
- [dol_cookbook.recipe_copy_between_backends](dol_cookbook.recipe_copy_between_backends.html.md): Recipe: copy data between two backends that use different formats.
- [dol_cookbook.recipe_files_as_text](dol_cookbook.recipe_files_as_text.html.md): Recipe: a folder as a &#96;{filename: text}&#96; mapping.
- [dol_cookbook.recipe_filter_keys](dol_cookbook.recipe_filter_keys.html.md): Recipe: expose only some of a store’s keys.
- [dol_cookbook.recipe_json_values](dol_cookbook.recipe_json_values.html.md): Recipe: store Python objects as JSON text.
- [dol_cookbook.recipe_translate_keys](dol_cookbook.recipe_translate_keys.html.md): Recipe: show friendly keys over a backend with awkward ones.
- [dol_cookbook.util](dol_cookbook.util.html.md): Utils for dol_cookbook.
